_comment: ÐMP Collection Manifest — Fixed Supply (type: fixed, criteria: explicit)
_doc: This is the canonical form for a fixed-supply PFP or art collection. All member inscription IDs are listed explicitly. supply must equal the length of criteria.inscription_ids. supply_locked prevents future updates from increasing the cap.
name: Doge Punks
description: 10,000 unique pixel art Doge characters inscribed on Dogecoin. The first iconic PFP collection on Dogecoin, fully on-chain and verifiable.

criteria._comment: In a real 10k collection this array would have 10,000 entries. Shown here with 3 for brevity.

_signing_note: sig_msg is the hex of the UTF-8 canonical JSON (all fields except sig/sig_msg, keys sorted). sig is the compact secp256k1 signature by creator_address over SHA256(SHA256(DOGE_MSG_PREFIX + varint_len + sig_msg_bytes)).
